name: Maple-Gochujang Chicken
subtitle: Roasted sweet potato, air-fried broccoli, spicy cucumber salad (oi-muchim)
equipment: 2 sheet pans, air fryer, small saucepan, thermometer
before: **2¼ lb chicken breast** thawed in the fridge.
Uses gochujang **paste**. Whisk it smooth with the liquids before heating.
notes: The glaze is reduced on the stove and tossed on at the end; maple syrup scorches if it's baked on at 425°F. The cucumber salad is for dinner only.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Racks lower-middle and upper-middle. An **empty sheet pan** on the lower rack. Heat to **425°F**.

steps.title: Sweet potatoes in
steps.body: Cut **2½ lb sweet potatoes** into ¾-inch cubes and toss with **1 Tbsp neutral oil + ¾ tsp salt**. Spread on the hot pan, lower rack.

steps.title: Chicken in
steps.body: Cut **2¼ lb chicken** into 1½-inch chunks and toss with **1 Tbsp neutral oil + 1 tsp salt + ½ tsp pepper**. Spread on the second pan, spaced apart. Upper rack, **15–18 min**.

steps.title: Cucumber and glaze, while it roasts
steps.body: Slice **1 cucumber** into ¼-inch half-moons and toss with **½ tsp salt**. In a small saucepan, whisk smooth: **¼ cup gochujang + 3 Tbsp maple + 2 Tbsp soy + 1 Tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp gochugaru + 3 cloves garlic, grated + 1 tsp ginger + 1 tsp sesame oil + 3 Tbsp water**.

steps.title: Flip potatoes, start broccoli
steps.body: Flip the sweet potatoes; **10–15 min more**. Toss **1½ lb broccoli** with **2 tsp oil + ¼ tsp salt** and air-fry at **390°F for 8–10 min** in 2 batches.

steps.title: Reduce the glaze
steps.body: Saucepan over **medium**, stirring, **3–4 min** until it coats a spoon. Taste: too salty → **+1 tsp maple**; too thick → **+1 Tbsp water**.

steps.title: Glaze the chicken
steps.body: Pull the chicken at **160°F** and rest 3 min. Toss it with the glaze in a large bowl. Top with **2 scallions + 1 Tbsp sesame seeds**.

steps.title: Cucumber salad
steps.body: Drain the cucumber and squeeze it gently. Toss with **1 tsp gochugaru + 1 clove garlic, grated + 1 scallion + 2 tsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp sugar + ½ tsp fish sauce + ½ tsp sesame oil + ½ tsp sesame seeds**.

after: Pack 3 lunches: chicken, sweet potato and broccoli.

macros.portion: About 5½ oz glazed chicken, 1 cup roasted sweet potato, 1 cup roasted broccoli and ½ cup cucumber salad.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.
